message.content:
I don’t have a way to probe your connection from here, so I can’t tell you the exact speed right now.  
But you can quickly find out by running a speed‑test on your own machine. Here are a few easy options:

---

## 1. Use an online speed‑test website  
Open a browser and go to one of these sites:

| Site | URL |
|------|-----|
| Speedtest by Ookla | https://www.speedtest.net |
| Fast.com (Netflix) | https://fast.com |
| Google Speed Test | type “speed test” in Google and click the built‑in test |

These will automatically ping a nearby server and give you download/upload speeds and ping.

---

## 2. Run a command‑line test (if you have `speedtest-cli`)

If you’re on Windows, macOS, or Linux and have Python installed, you can install the `speedtest-cli` package and run it from the terminal.

```bash
# Install the tool (requires pip)
pip install speedtest-cli

# Run a test
speedtest
```

If you prefer a one‑liner that doesn’t require installing anything, you can try the following (works on Windows PowerShell or CMD if `curl` is available):

```powershell
curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sivel/speedtest-cli/master/speedtest.py | python -
```

---

## 3. Use Windows built‑in “Network Speed Test”

If you’re on Windows 10/11, you can use the built‑in “Network Speed Test” app:

1. Press **Win + S** and type “Network Speed Test”.
2. Click the app and let it run.

---

### Quick Command (Windows PowerShell)

If you just want a quick test without installing anything, try this PowerShell command (requires PowerShell 5+):

```powershell
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://speed.hetzner.de/100MB.bin" -OutFile "$env:TEMP\speedtest.bin" -UseBasicParsing
```

It downloads a 100 MB file from Hetzner’s test server; you can then calculate the speed from the time it takes.

---

**Tip:**  
- Run the test when no other heavy downloads/uploads are happening for the most accurate result.  
- Repeat a couple of times and average the numbers.

Let me know if you’d like help installing `speedtest-cli` or interpreting the results!
